summary: Turn supplier sustainability requirements into procurement controls, evidence checks, and remediation routines. Explore the course and plan your training.
lede: Supplier sustainability due diligence training helps procurement and compliance teams assess supplier risks and connect evidence to sourcing decisions. It covers supplier responsibility mapping, evidence checks, risk prioritisation, and corrective-action planning, with practice building risk registers and supplier scorecards. Cooperative leaders and others responsible for supplier requirements or sustainability findings can use these methods to support consistent procurement and governance decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who set supplier requirements, review sustainability evidence, or translate supplier findings into commercial and governance decisions across agribusiness commodity chains.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with agribusiness procurement, supplier onboarding, or sustainability and compliance responsibilities is expected. No coding is required; exercises use supplier-governance documents and spreadsheet-based tracking.
